rows.ARS:
Deep pink Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: Heidi Jayne
rows.Origin:
Bred by L. Esser & Son (United Kingdom, 1986).
Introduced in United Kingdom by R Harkness & Co. Ltd. as 'Heidi Jayne'.
rows.Bloom: Deep pink. Strong fragrance. 32 petals. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 10b. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
